items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Norm directly; the interviewer mentions 'Norm' in the context of Professor Mineta's uncle and brass bands, but the interviewee only responds to questions about Mineta's family background.

ctx.x: Because I know some of Professor Mineta's uncle even, Norm, he always speaks of him as his uncle, Norm, that played trumpet way back even... Well, that probably was his teacher. Might have been his teacher in Boston.
